components.name: FFmpeg (ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe)
notice: ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe, installed in the same folder as Blinkify.exe, are FFmpeg, licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 or later. The build enables no GPL, non-free or version-3 component.

They are separate programs. Blinkify starts them as child processes and does not link them into itself. You may replace them with your own build of FFmpeg: Blinkify runs whichever ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe are in its installation folder.

They are built from the unmodified FFmpeg source named below, with the configure line below, by the script published at https://github.com/ismetcahangirov/blinkify/tree/main/tools/ffmpeg-sidecar. The libraries built into them are listed next, each with its own licence.
